relationships.subject: ACC pyramidal neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: hyperactivity of pyramidal neurons (PNs) in the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) drives insomnia in a mouse model of nerve-injury-induced chronic pain

relationships.subject: ACC pyramidal neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: the ACC projection to the dorsal medial striatum (DMS) underlies chronic-pain-induced insomnia through enhanced activity and plasticity of ACC-DMS dopamine D1R neuron synapses

key_findings: ACC pyramidal neuron hyperactivity drives insomnia after nerve injury.
ACC-DMS D1R synapse enhancement underlies pain-induced insomnia.
